```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(isdas)
library(gstat)
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(opendatatoronto)
library(dplyr)
library(jsonlite)
library(writexl)
library(ggplot2)
library(rgeoda)
```


```{r}
#transpose so rows = cols
df_transposed <-nbhdata %>%
    t() %>%
    as.data.frame()

colnames(df_transposed) <- df_transposed[1, ]
df_transposed <-df_transposed[-1, ]

df_transposed[] <- lapply(df_transposed, type.convert, as.is = TRUE)

df_transposed
```
# centroids
```{r}
df_transposed_sf <- st_as_sf(torontonbh$geometry,
                             coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
                             crs = 4326)


nbh_centroids <- st_centroid(df_transposed_sf)

```

#Distance to bikeshare hub
```{r}
dist_matrix_age <-st_distance(nbh_centroids, stations_sf)

df_transposed_sf$dist_to_nearest_hub <- apply(dist_matrix_age, 1, min)

summary(df_transposed_sf$dist_to_nearest_hub)

ggplot(torontonbh) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = df_transposed_sf$dist_to_nearest_hub)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", direction = -1) +
  geom_sf(data = stations_sf, color = "black", size = 1.5) +
  labs(title = "Distance to Nearest Bikeshare Hub by Neighbourhood",
       fill = "Distance (m)") +
  theme_minimal()

```


```{r}
#renaming median income col for readability

names(df_transposed)[164] <- "MI"

```

```{r}

MI_vector <- df_transposed$MI #creates vector
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
#creating MI_vector to a df
MI_df <- data.frame(MI_vector)
```


```{r}
#adding MI from df_trans to df_trans_sf 
df_transposed_sf$MI <- MI_df

names(df_transposed_sf)[3] <- "MI"

```


#Bivariate Moran's I for bike access and median income
```{r}
weights_MI <- queen_weights(torontodata)

lisa_MI <- local_bimoran(weights_MI,
                          df_transposed_sf[c("MI", "dist_to_nearest_hub")])

df_transposed_sf$lisa_cluster <- lisa_clusters(lisa_MI)
df_transposed_sf$lisa_pvalue <-lisa_pvalues(lisa_MI)
```


```{r}
class(df_transposed_sf)
```


```{r}
df_transposed_sf <-df_transposed_sf %>%
  mutate(cluster_label = case_when(
    lisa_pvalue > 0.05 ~ "Not Sig",
    lisa_cluster == 1 ~ "HH",
    lisa_cluster == 2 ~ "LL",
    lisa_cluster == 3 ~ "HL",
    lisa_cluster == 4 ~ "LH",
    TRUE              ~ "Not sig"
  ))

ggplot(df_transposed_sf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = cluster_label)) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("HH" = "#a3b18a","LL" = "#e9edc9","HL" = "#fefae0","LH" = "#606c38","Not sig" = "#faedcd")) + 
  labs(title = "BV LISA_MI",
       fill = "Cluster Type") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
#renaming median income col for readability
names(df_transposed)[35] <- "AGE"

AGE_vector <- df_transposed$AGE #creates vector
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}

AGE_df <- data.frame(AGE_vector)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
#adding MI from df_trans to df_trans_sf 
df_transposed_sf$AGE <- AGE_df

names(df_transposed_sf)[9] <- "AGE"
```

```{r}
# Step 1: extract vector directly (skip the data.frame() step entirely)
AGE_vector <- df_transposed$AGE

# Step 2: add as vector directly
df_transposed_sf$AGE <- AGE_vector

# Step 3: now local_bimoran will find the column correctly
weights_AGE <- queen_weights(torontodata)

lisa_AGE <- local_bimoran(weights_AGE,
                          df_transposed_sf[c("AGE", "dist_to_nearest_hub")])

df_transposed_sf$lisa_cluster <- lisa_clusters(lisa_AGE)
df_transposed_sf$lisa_pvalue  <- lisa_pvalues(lisa_AGE)
```

#Bivariate Moran's I for bike access and age
```{r}

class(df_transposed_sf)
```

